Remark
[Parallel Ricci and scalar curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0122 ↗ def:pet-ch3-ricci-curvature ↗ def:pet-ch3-scalar-curvature

1. ch3:3.4.7Show that a Riemannian manifold with parallel Ricci tensor has constant scalar curvature. (The converse fails, and a metric with parallel curvature tensor need not be Einstein.)
